author: CthulhuandCoffee
text:
Dungeons & Dragons was never intended for the corporate world. It was designed as a small-scale, analog hobby that uses IMAGINATION, promotes COLLABORATION, and doesn't require a lot of money to play. 

It encourages IMPROVISATION, CREATIVITY, and FACE-TO-FACE INTERACTION.

In a word, it is a thought experiment that requires paper and pencil—NOT MONETIZATION OR PLATFORM CONTROL.

Who owns Dungeons & Dragons?

We do.

You are free to play in the privacy of your own home any way you see fit.

Game on!

#OSR #dungeonsanddragons #ttrpg

D&D was always meant to be able to be played by flashlight, on a bus, at lunch or at anywhere you had a table. If you had a d20 and some friends you had a game.

And you were made fun of.

Jocks, hot-chicks and rockers pretending they played back the day is just embarrassing.
